def transform(grid):
    # Extract each separate nonzero object and concatenate their 3x3 patterns
    # in ascending color order.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    p = (y+dy, x+dx)
                    if 0 <= p[0] < h and 0 <= p[1] < w and p not in seen and grid[p[0]][p[1]] == color:
                        seen.add(p)
                        stack.append(p)
            objects.append((color, cells))
    objects.sort(key=lambda item: min(c for r, c in item[1]))
    out = [[0] * (3 * len(objects)) for _ in range(3)]
    for i, (color, cells) in enumerate(objects):
        r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
        c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
        for r, c in cells:
            out[r-r0][3*i + c-c0] = color
    return out
